title: Ask a question on the board
done: That is it: the menu opens where you clicked; choose Add question and type.

steps.caption: Right-click the place on the board your question is about.

steps.text: Should the cache sit before the reader?
steps.caption: Type the question. Its pointer already points at the place you clicked.
Press Enter. The question waits on the board until you press Review.
Your turn: right-click the board to ask a question of your own.
